snippet.title: Hazard Pay | Your First Shift Begins - Release Date Reveal
snippet.description:
Coming to Steam, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch on 10th September.
Find out more: https://numskullgames.com/game/hazard-pay/

Leave no trace. Ask no questions. Try to stay alive.

Set in an alternative 1982, Hazard Pay puts you in the boots of a disposable clean-up worker employed by IPT, a corporation responsible for catastrophic biohazard incidents. Armed with a trusty mop and bucket and a knack for problem solving, your job is to erase all evidence of wrongdoing in a series of increasingly complex (and horrifying) handcrafted Sokoban-like puzzles.
